text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-t-a-g-e-d a n-o-n-i-n-j-u-r-y t-o m-i-m-i-c a w-o-r-k-p-l-a-c-e a-c-c-i-d, l-e-f-t d-i-s-c-r-e-p-a-n-c-y t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p-s i-n v-i-d-e-o f-o-o-t-a-g-e, a-n-d n-e-v-e-r v-e-r-i-f-i-e-d t-h-e i-n-j-u-r-y d-a-t-e a-g-a-i-n-s-t f-a-c-t-o-r y a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g-s.
2) t-h-e y c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d a c-o-w-o-r-k-e-r t-o p-r-o-v-i-d-e a f-a-l-s-e a-c-c-o-u-n-t o-f t-h-e e-v-e-n-t, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g a c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t-i-n-g w-i-t-n-e-s-s s-t-a-t-e-m-e-n-t, w-h-i-l-e o-v-e-r-s-i-g-h-t-i-n-g t-h-e s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d c-r-o-s-s-e-x-a-m i-n-t-e-r-r-o-g-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l.
3) t-h-e y a-p-p-r-o-a-c-h-e-d t-h-e m-e-d-i-c-a-l p-r-o-v-i-d-e-r t-o m-i-s-r-e-p-r-e-s-e n-t t-h-e s-y-m-p-t-o-m s e-t, r-e-s-u-l-t-i-n-g i-n a l-t-e-r-e-d c-l-i-n-i-c-a-l n-o-t-e s, b-u-t f-a-i-l-e-d t-o c-o-n-f-i-r-m t-h-e d-o-c-t-o-r u-n-d-e-r-s-t-o-o-d t-h-e e-t-h-i-c-a-l b-r-o-a-d w-a-r-n-i-n-g-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d m-e-d-i-c-a-l r-e-c-o-r-d-s t-o a-l-i-g-n w-i-t-h t-h-e f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d n-a-r-r-a-t-i-v-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g e-d-i-t t-r-a-c-e-s i-n t-h-e e-l-e-c-t-r-o-n-i-c h-e-a-l-t-h f-i-l-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y a-u-d-i-t.
5) t-h-e y s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d t-h-e c-l-a-i-m t-o t-h-e i-n-s-u-r-a-n-c-e f-i-r-m, e-x-p-e-c-t-i-n-g i-t t-o e-v-a-d-e d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n, w-h-i-l-e i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g t-h-e s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d f-r-a-u-d a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s c-h-e-c-k-l-i-s-t t-h-a-t f-l-a-g-s t-i-m-i-n-g a-n-o-m-a-l-i-e-s a-n-d m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d r-e-c-o-r-d-s.
